title: oncidium dichromum
intro: Oncidium dichromum, commonly known as the Red Lip Orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the Oncidiinae subtribe. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oncidium dichromum include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Oncidium dichromum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
